name: Sri Lanka
shortSummary: India and Sri Lanka maintain close ties strengthened by India's $4 billion-plus support package during Sri Lanka's 2022 economic crisis, though the relationship carries legacy sensitivities from the IPKF intervention and Tamil minority issues.
complexity: India's 1987-90 IPKF peacekeeping intervention remains a sensitive memory; the unresolved political status of Sri Lanka's Tamil minority (13th Amendment devolution) continues to be a point of engagement.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India's 2022 support package covered fuel, food and currency stabilisation.
Indian investment in Sri Lankan solar and wind projects.

majorChallenges.title: Fishermen disputes
majorChallenges.description: Recurring arrests of Indian and Sri Lankan fishermen crossing the maritime boundary in the Palk Strait.

majorChallenges.title: Chinese port investments
majorChallenges.description: Chinese-financed projects such as Hambantota Port raise Indian strategic concerns.

recentDevelopments.title: Post-crisis economic engagement continues
recentDevelopments.description: India continued supporting Sri Lanka's economic recovery following the 2022 crisis, including renewable energy investment.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Consolidated India's standing as Sri Lanka's most reliable crisis-era partner.

historicalEvents.title: Indo-Sri Lanka Accord and IPKF Deployment
historicalEvents.description: India deploys the Indian Peace Keeping Force to Sri Lanka to help implement a Tamil devolution accord amid civil war; the mission withdraws in 1990 after significant casualties.

historicalEvents.title: India-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement
historicalEvents.description: ISFTA comes into force, becoming one of India's earliest bilateral free trade agreements.

historicalEvents.title: Economic Crisis Support
historicalEvents.description: India extends over $4 billion in credit lines, currency swaps and fuel assistance as Sri Lanka faces its worst economic crisis since independence.
historicalEvents.impact: Positioned India as Sri Lanka's first responder during the crisis, expanding its regional standing.

agreements.name: India-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement (ISFTA)
agreements.description: Bilateral free trade agreement covering goods trade between the two countries.

defenceCooperation.name: Dosti trilateral exercise
defenceCooperation.description: India, Sri Lanka and Maldives coast guard exercise focused on maritime security.

multilateralRelations.detail: India-led regional maritime security grouping including Sri Lanka, Maldives and Mauritius.
